c-3541ae0f26f7c80c.texto: Moppets, “battle-ax,” is defined by Gesenius to be “a mallet, a maul, a war-club”; and he makes it identical with mephits, which in Proverbs 25:18 is rendered “maul.” Others, however, think that a heavy bladed instrument is meant.
